text: The giant fiber's spike timing, relative to parallel escape circuits, decides between a long-duration escape that starts stable flight and a short, fast takeoff.
cite: von Reyn et al. 2014, Nat Neurosci 17:962-970
game_note: Looming detectors LPLC2 and LC4 drive it in the sim (validated); the game makes the fly dodge above 4x calm.

text: Its cross-shaped dendrites sit in the four T4/T5 motion layers, so it fires for an object expanding radially outward (a looming stimulus) and rejects other motion.
A visual projection neuron that feeds the giant fiber; removing this input during looming shows it encodes how fast the object expands, while other inputs encode its size.
checked: abstract and the dataset paper's reference list naming LC4 for this study, PubMed and PMC, 2026-09-30

text: The moonwalker descending neuron: blocking it stops backward walking, and activating it makes the fly walk backward.
game_note: Its target motor neurons fail validation in this sim; the BACK UP reaction is a GAME RULE.

text: P9: activating it starts forward walking with ipsilateral turning; it is needed for a male to pursue a female during courtship.
A proboscis motor neuron: activating it lifts the rostrum, consistent with contracting muscle 9.
cite: Schwarz et al. 2017, eLife 6:e19892 (confirming Gordon & Scott 2009)

text: These are the dataset's aDN1 and aDN2. Activating antennal-grooming descending neurons elicits the stereotyped leg movements that groom the antennae.
checked: abstract, Crossref; the aDN1/aDN2 names are the dataset's own synonym for these types, 2026-09-30
game_note: Antennal touch to aDN is validated in this sim; aDN to the front-leg motor neurons is not.

text: Recordings in walking flies show its activity predicts low-gain steering (DNa02, recruited first and more transient, predicts high-gain steering).
Its activity predicts high-gain, transient steering; turning velocity is linearly related to the right-minus-left difference in DNa02 activity.
game_note: The game turns the fly by DNa01 + DNa02, right minus left.

text: A subset of the PAM cluster's dopamine neurons signals sugar reward to the mushroom body: sugar ingestion activates them, and activating them can stand in for the reward.
game_note: Sugar drives them directly in the game (GAME RULE); the reward meter reads their firing.

text: Dopamine neurons of the PPL1 cluster can induce aversive odor memories in the mushroom body, with different stability for different pathways.
game_note: Pain drives them in the game (GAME RULE); training weakens Kenyon cell to MBON synapses while they fire.

text: An odor activates only a sparse subset of Kenyon cells, and this sparse code holds up across a range of odors.
MBON-gamma5beta'2a, one glutamatergic cell, in the M4/M6 group whose output is required for appetitive and aversive memory performance.
cite: Aso et al. 2014, eLife 3:e04577 (naming); Owald et al. 2015, Neuron 86:417-427
checked: Table 1 of Aso et al. 2014 e04577 (PMC4273437) for the name, cell count and transmitter; Owald 2015 abstract (PubMed) for the role; re-checked by review 2026-09-30

text: MBON-alpha3, a cholinergic output neuron of the V3/V4 group (two cells); silencing lines covering that group implicated it in 2-hour appetitive memory.
cite: Aso et al. 2014, eLife 3:e04577 (naming); Aso et al. 2014, eLife 3:e04580 (memory)
checked: name, cell count and transmitter: Table 1 of e04577 (PMC4273437); the 2-hour appetitive memory statement is in e04580's text (PMC4273436), which Day 1 had read but cited as e04577; corrected by review 2026-09-30

text: A descending neuron in the brain that, with P1, mediates the decision to sing and to act on it; it links the brain to the thoracic song circuit.
game_note: pIP10 to the ps1 wing motor neurons is validated in this sim. Nothing in play drives pIP10.

text: The pC1 types the game counts as P1 (the clone called pMP-e or pMP4 in the literature). P1 neurons trigger the male courtship ritual, and their activity gates how strongly visual LC10a neurons drive pursuit of a female.
checked: abstract, PubMed; the list of pC1 types is the game's own (assays.P1_TYPES, from the dataset's synonyms), 2026-09-30
game_note: P1 to the ps1 song neurons is too weak in this sim (validation FAIL).

text: LC10 neurons respond to small moving objects and carry the visual information a male needs to orient toward and stay near a female during courtship; silencing them abolishes that.
game_note: The game steers the fly with LC10 on the same side as DNa02 (GAME RULE).

text: E-PG neurons tile the ellipsoid body and the protocerebral bridge; the position of their activity peak tracks the fly's heading.
game_note: No heading bump forms in this sim (validation FAIL).

text: Olfactory neurons carrying the receptor Or67d: the male pheromone cVA acts through them to regulate mating behavior (inhibiting it in males, promoting it in females).
CO2 activates a single antennal-lobe glomerulus, V, and the sensory neurons innervating it are needed for the fly's innate avoidance of CO2.
The dataset names this type "Asahina 2014: TK-FruM". Tachykinin-expressing FruM neurons are male-specific; activating them raises, and silencing lowers, aggression between males.
checked: abstract, PubMed; the type-to-paper link is the dataset's own annotation, 2026-09-30

text: T4 cells respond to moving bright edges and T5 cells to dark edges; each subtype is tuned to one of four cardinal directions, and each terminates in its own sublayer of the lobula plate.
game_note: Rightward rotation drives T4a/T5a_R + T4b/T5b_L then DNa_R in this sim (validated); the EMD stage is a GAME RULE, Lab only.

text: The PDF-expressing ventral lateral neurons (small and large LNv) restore morning activity when the clock runs only in them, and can drive 24-hour rhythms alone in constant darkness.
game_note: Daylight drives them directly in the game (GAME RULE).

text: Activating neurons that project to the dorsal fan-shaped body (layers 6-7) puts flies into a sleep-like quiescent state. Shown on every FB6/FB7 type: the dataset doesn't say which of them the paper's neurons are.
game_note: The game's SLEEP readout is FB6/FB7 firing; these layers being the dorsal fan-shaped body is the game's reading of the dataset.

text: Johnston's organ, the antennal mechanosensory organ, holds separate neuron subsets for wind, near-field sound and gravity, projecting to different regions of the central brain.
cite: Yorozu et al. 2009, Nature 458:201-205; Kamikouchi et al. 2009, Nature 458:165-171
checked: abstracts, PubMed, 2026-09-30. The pack names these JO-CA1, JO-CM, JO-ED1, JO-EV3 and so on, hence the prefixes (review found the exact names JO-C/JO-E match no type). Which subset is JO-C/E is the game's annotation-based choice, not claimed by these papers
game_note: The fan's wind drives JO-C/E in the game (CONNECTOME sensors, GAME RULE wind).

text: The dataset's synonym names these 'Sugar SEL PN' (Yao & Scott 2022). In that study the sugar-responsive serotonergic neurons of the lateral subesophageal cluster, which the authors call sugar-SELs, excite the insulin-producing cells and limit consumption.
checked: abstract (Europe PMC) and the Results passage that defines the names sugar-SELs and bitter-SELs (PMC8930643, read through a summary of the page, not line by line); that these two types are those neurons rests on the dataset's own synonym, 2026-10-03
game_note: Sugar-pathway taste neurons excite them in the sim (the sugar_feeding validation chooses its sugar set by their wiring); nothing in play reads them.

text: The dataset's synonym names this 'Bitter-SEL' (Yao & Scott 2022). In that study the serotonergic neurons that respond to bitter compounds, the bitter-SELs, activate enteric neurons to promote gastric motility.
checked: abstract (Europe PMC) and the Results passage that defines the names (PMC8930643, read through a summary of the page); that this type is those neurons rests on the dataset's own synonym, 2026-10-03
game_note: Bitter-pathway taste neurons excite it in the sim (validated as activation, not avoidance); nothing in play reads it.
